title: Vegan Casserole Delight
description: A warm, creamy, and satisfying vegan casserole perfect for any meal.
instructions: Grease a 9x13 inch baking dish with olive oil.
In a large mixing bowl, combine sweet potato and chickpeas.
In a separate bowl, mix together vegan cream cheese and nutritional yeast.
Add the vegan mozzarella shreds to the cream cheese mixture and stir until well combined.
Pour the cream cheese mixture over the sweet potato and chickpea mixture.
Stir until everything is well coated.
Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is hot and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let it cool for a few minutes before serving.
